005package org.wpilib.math.linalg;
006
007import org.ejml.LinearSolverSafe;
008import org.ejml.data.DMatrixRMaj;
009import org.ejml.dense.row.factory.LinearSolverFactory_DDRM;
010import org.ejml.interfaces.linsol.LinearSolverDense;
011import org.ejml.simple.SimpleMatrix;
012import org.wpilib.math.system.LinearSystemUtil;
013import org.wpilib.math.util.Num;
014
015/** DARE solver utility functions. */
016public final class DARE {
017  private DARE() {
018    throw new UnsupportedOperationException("This is a utility class!");
019  }
020
021  /**
022   * Computes the unique stabilizing solution X to the discrete-time algebraic Riccati equation.
023   *
024   * <p>AᵀXA − X − AᵀXB(BᵀXB + R)⁻¹BᵀXA + Q = 0
025   *
026   * <p>This internal function skips expensive precondition checks for increased performance. The
027   * solver may hang if any of the following occur:
028   *
029   * <ul>
030   *   <li>Q isn't symmetric positive semidefinite
031   *   <li>R isn't symmetric positive definite
032   *   <li>The (A, B) pair isn't stabilizable
033   *   <li>The (A, C) pair where Q = CᵀC isn't detectable
034   * </ul>
035   *
036   * <p>Only use this function if you're sure the preconditions are met.
037   *
038   * @param <States> Number of states.
039   * @param A System matrix.
040   * @param B Input matrix.
041   * @param Q State cost matrix.
042   * @param R_llt The LLT decomposition of the input cost matrix.
043   * @return Solution of DARE.
044   */
045  private static <States extends Num> Matrix<States, States> dareDetail(
046      SimpleMatrix A, SimpleMatrix B, SimpleMatrix Q, LinearSolverDense<DMatrixRMaj> R_llt) {
047    // Implements SDA algorithm on p. 5 of [1] (initial A, G, H are from (4)).
048    //
049    // [1] E. K.-W. Chu, H.-Y. Fan, W.-W. Lin & C.-S. Wang "Structure-Preserving
050    //     Algorithms for Periodic Discrete-Time Algebraic Riccati Equations",
051    //     International Journal of Control, 77:8, 767-788, 2004.
052    //     DOI: 10.1080/00207170410001714988
053
054    // A₀ = A
055    // G₀ = BR⁻¹Bᵀ
056    // H₀ = Q
057    var A_k = A;
058    var Rinv_BT = new SimpleMatrix(A.getNumRows(), A.getNumCols());
059    R_llt.solve(B.transpose().getDDRM(), Rinv_BT.getDDRM());
060    var G_k = B.mult(Rinv_BT);
061    SimpleMatrix H_k;
062    var H_k1 = Q;
063
064    var W_solver = LinearSolverFactory_DDRM.lu(A.getNumRows());
065    var V_1 = new SimpleMatrix(A.getNumRows(), A.getNumCols());
066    var V_2 = new SimpleMatrix(A.getNumRows(), A.getNumCols());
067
068    do {
069      H_k = H_k1;
070
071      // W = I + GₖHₖ
072      var W = SimpleMatrix.identity(H_k.getNumRows()).plus(G_k.mult(H_k));
073
074      W_solver.setA(W.getDDRM());
075
076      // Solve WV₁ = Aₖ for V₁
077      W_solver.solve(A_k.getDDRM(), V_1.getDDRM());
078
079      // Solve V₂Wᵀ = Gₖ for V₂
080      //
081      // V₂Wᵀ = Gₖ
082      // V₂ = Gₖ / Wᵀ
083      // V₂ = (W \ Gₖᵀ)ᵀ
084      // V₂ = W \ Gₖ since Gₖ and V₂ are symmetric
085      W_solver.solve(G_k.getDDRM(), V_2.getDDRM());
086
087      // Gₖ₊₁ = Gₖ + AₖV₂Aₖᵀ
088      // Hₖ₊₁ = Hₖ + V₁ᵀHₖAₖ
089      // Aₖ₊₁ = AₖV₁
090      G_k = G_k.plus(A_k.mult(V_2).mult(A_k.transpose()));
091      H_k1 = H_k.plus(V_1.transpose().mult(H_k).mult(A_k));
092      A_k = A_k.mult(V_1);
093
094      // while |Hₖ₊₁ − Hₖ| > ε |Hₖ₊₁|
095    } while (H_k1.minus(H_k).normF() > 1e-10 * H_k1.normF());
096
097    return new Matrix<>(H_k1);
098  }
099
100  /**
101   * Computes the unique stabilizing solution X to the discrete-time algebraic Riccati equation.
102   *
103   * <p>AᵀXA − X − AᵀXB(BᵀXB + R)⁻¹BᵀXA + Q = 0
104   *
105   * <p>This internal function skips expensive precondition checks for increased performance. The
106   * solver may hang if any of the following occur:
107   *
108   * <ul>
109   *   <li>Q isn't symmetric positive semidefinite
110   *   <li>R isn't symmetric positive definite
111   *   <li>The (A, B) pair isn't stabilizable
112   *   <li>The (A, C) pair where Q = CᵀC isn't detectable
113   * </ul>
114   *
115   * <p>Only use this function if you're sure the preconditions are met.
116   *
117   * @param <States> Number of states.
118   * @param <Inputs> Number of inputs.
119   * @param A System matrix.
120   * @param B Input matrix.
121   * @param Q State cost matrix.
122   * @param R Input cost matrix.
123   * @return Solution of DARE.
124   */
125  public static <States extends Num, Inputs extends Num> Matrix<States, States> dareNoPrecond(
126      Matrix<States, States> A,
127      Matrix<States, Inputs> B,
128      Matrix<States, States> Q,
129      Matrix<Inputs, Inputs> R) {
130    var R_llt = new LinearSolverSafe<DMatrixRMaj>(LinearSolverFactory_DDRM.chol(R.getNumRows()));
131    R_llt.setA(R.getStorage().getDDRM());
132    return dareDetail(A.getStorage(), B.getStorage(), Q.getStorage(), R_llt);
133  }
134
135  /**
136   * Computes the unique stabilizing solution X to the discrete-time algebraic Riccati equation.
137   *
138   * <p>AᵀXA − X − (AᵀXB + N)(BᵀXB + R)⁻¹(BᵀXA + Nᵀ) + Q = 0
139   *
140   * <p>This is equivalent to solving the original DARE:
141   *
142   * <p>A₂ᵀXA₂ − X − A₂ᵀXB(BᵀXB + R)⁻¹BᵀXA₂ + Q₂ = 0
143   *
144   * <p>where A₂ and Q₂ are a change of variables:
145   *
146   * <p>A₂ = A − BR⁻¹Nᵀ and Q₂ = Q − NR⁻¹Nᵀ
147   *
148   * <p>This overload of the DARE is useful for finding the control law uₖ that minimizes the
149   * following cost function subject to xₖ₊₁ = Axₖ + Buₖ.
150   *
151   * <pre>
152   *     ∞ [xₖ]ᵀ[Q  N][xₖ]
153   * J = Σ [uₖ] [Nᵀ R][uₖ] ΔT
154   *    k=0
155   * </pre>
156   *
157   * <p>This is a more general form of the following. The linear-quadratic regulator is the feedback
158   * control law uₖ that minimizes the following cost function subject to xₖ₊₁ = Axₖ + Buₖ:
159   *
160   * <pre>
161   *     ∞
162   * J = Σ (xₖᵀQxₖ + uₖᵀRuₖ) ΔT
163   *    k=0
164   * </pre>
165   *
166   * <p>This can be refactored as:
167   *
168   * <pre>
169   *     ∞ [xₖ]ᵀ[Q 0][xₖ]
170   * J = Σ [uₖ] [0 R][uₖ] ΔT
171   *    k=0
172   * </pre>
173   *
174   * <p>This internal function skips expensive precondition checks for increased performance. The
175   * solver may hang if any of the following occur:
176   *
177   * <ul>
178   *   <li>Q₂ isn't symmetric positive semidefinite
179   *   <li>R isn't symmetric positive definite
180   *   <li>The (A₂, B) pair isn't stabilizable
181   *   <li>The (A₂, C) pair where Q₂ = CᵀC isn't detectable
182   * </ul>
183   *
184   * <p>Only use this function if you're sure the preconditions are met.
185   *
186   * @param <States> Number of states.
187   * @param <Inputs> Number of inputs.
188   * @param A System matrix.
189   * @param B Input matrix.
190   * @param Q State cost matrix.
191   * @param R Input cost matrix.
192   * @param N State-input cross-term cost matrix.
193   * @return Solution of DARE.
194   */
195  public static <States extends Num, Inputs extends Num> Matrix<States, States> dareNoPrecond(
196      Matrix<States, States> A,
197      Matrix<States, Inputs> B,
198      Matrix<States, States> Q,
199      Matrix<Inputs, Inputs> R,
200      Matrix<States, Inputs> N) {
201    var R_llt = new LinearSolverSafe<DMatrixRMaj>(LinearSolverFactory_DDRM.chol(R.getNumRows()));
202    R_llt.setA(R.getStorage().getDDRM());
203    var Rinv_NT = new SimpleMatrix(A.getNumRows(), A.getNumCols());
204    R_llt.solve(B.getStorage().transpose().getDDRM(), Rinv_NT.getDDRM());
205
206    // This is a change of variables to make the DARE that includes Q, R, and N
207    // cost matrices fit the form of the DARE that includes only Q and R cost
208    // matrices.
209    //
210    // This is equivalent to solving the original DARE:
211    //
212    //   A₂ᵀXA₂ − X − A₂ᵀXB(BᵀXB + R)⁻¹BᵀXA₂ + Q₂ = 0
213    //
214    // where A₂ and Q₂ are a change of variables:
215    //
216    //   A₂ = A − BR⁻¹Nᵀ and Q₂ = Q − NR⁻¹Nᵀ
217    R_llt.solve(N.getStorage().transpose().getDDRM(), Rinv_NT.getDDRM());
218    var A_2 = A.getStorage().minus(B.getStorage().mult(Rinv_NT));
219    var Q_2 = Q.getStorage().minus(N.getStorage().mult(Rinv_NT));
220
221    return dareDetail(A_2, B.getStorage(), Q_2, R_llt);
222  }
223
224  /**
225   * Computes the unique stabilizing solution X to the discrete-time algebraic Riccati equation.
226   *
227   * <p>AᵀXA − X − AᵀXB(BᵀXB + R)⁻¹BᵀXA + Q = 0
228   *
229   * @param <States> Number of states.
230   * @param <Inputs> Number of inputs.
231   * @param A System matrix.
232   * @param B Input matrix.
233   * @param Q State cost matrix.
234   * @param R Input cost matrix.
235   * @return Solution of DARE.
236   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if Q isn't symmetric positive semidefinite.
237   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if R isn't symmetric positive definite.
238   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the (A, B) pair isn't stabilizable.
239   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the (A, C) pair where Q = CᵀC isn't detectable.
240   */
241  public static <States extends Num, Inputs extends Num> Matrix<States, States> dare(
242      Matrix<States, States> A,
243      Matrix<States, Inputs> B,
244      Matrix<States, States> Q,
245      Matrix<Inputs, Inputs> R) {
246    // Require R be symmetric
247    if (R.minus(R.transpose()).normF() > 1e-10) {
248      throw new IllegalArgumentException("R was not symmetric.\n\n" + R);
249    }
250
251    // Require R be positive definite
252    var R_llt = new LinearSolverSafe<DMatrixRMaj>(LinearSolverFactory_DDRM.chol(R.getNumRows()));
253    if (!R_llt.setA(R.getStorage().getDDRM())) {
254      throw new IllegalArgumentException("R was not positive definite.\n\n" + R);
255    }
256
257    // Require Q be symmetric
258    if (Q.minus(Q.transpose()).normF() > 1e-10) {
259      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Q was not symmetric.\n\n" + Q);
260    }
261
262    // Require Q be positive semidefinite
263    var Q_es = Q.getStorage().eig();
264    for (var e : Q_es.getEigenvalues()) {
265      if (e.real < 0.0) {
266        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Q was not positive semidefinite.\n\n" + Q);
267      }
268    }
269
270    // Require (A, B) pair be stabilizable
271    if (!LinearSystemUtil.isStabilizable(A, B)) {
272      throw new IllegalArgumentException("(A, B) pair was not stabilizable.\n\n" + A + "\n" + B);
273    }
274
275    // Find C in Q = CᵀC
276    var C = new SimpleMatrix(Q.getNumRows(), Q.getNumCols());
277    for (int row = 0; row < Q.getNumRows(); ++row) {
278      var e = Q_es.getEigenvalue(row);
279      var v = Q_es.getEigenVector(row);
280      if (v == null) {
281        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Q was not positive semidefinite.\n\n" + Q);
282      }
283      for (int col = 0; col < Q.getNumRows(); ++col) {
284        // We use e.real because the eigenvalues of a real symmetric matrix are
285        // always real
286        C.set(row, col, Math.sqrt(e.real) * v.get(col, 0));
287      }
288    }
289
290    // Require (A, C) pair be detectable where Q = CᵀC
291    if (!LinearSystemUtil.isDetectable(A, new Matrix<>(C))) {
292      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
293          "(A, C) pair where Q = CᵀC was not detectable.\n\n" + A + "\n" + C);
294    }
295
296    return dareDetail(A.getStorage(), B.getStorage(), Q.getStorage(), R_llt);
297  }
298
299  /**
300   * Computes the unique stabilizing solution X to the discrete-time algebraic Riccati equation.
301   *
302   * <p>AᵀXA − X − (AᵀXB + N)(BᵀXB + R)⁻¹(BᵀXA + Nᵀ) + Q = 0
303   *
304   * <p>This is equivalent to solving the original DARE:
305   *
306   * <p>A₂ᵀXA₂ − X − A₂ᵀXB(BᵀXB + R)⁻¹BᵀXA₂ + Q₂ = 0
307   *
308   * <p>where A₂ and Q₂ are a change of variables:
309   *
310   * <p>A₂ = A − BR⁻¹Nᵀ and Q₂ = Q − NR⁻¹Nᵀ
311   *
312   * <p>This overload of the DARE is useful for finding the control law uₖ that minimizes the
313   * following cost function subject to xₖ₊₁ = Axₖ + Buₖ.
314   *
315   * <pre>
316   *     ∞ [xₖ]ᵀ[Q  N][xₖ]
317   * J = Σ [uₖ] [Nᵀ R][uₖ] ΔT
318   *    k=0
319   * </pre>
320   *
321   * <p>This is a more general form of the following. The linear-quadratic regulator is the feedback
322   * control law uₖ that minimizes the following cost function subject to xₖ₊₁ = Axₖ + Buₖ:
323   *
324   * <pre>
325   *     ∞
326   * J = Σ (xₖᵀQxₖ + uₖᵀRuₖ) ΔT
327   *    k=0
328   * </pre>
329   *
330   * <p>This can be refactored as:
331   *
332   * <pre>
333   *     ∞ [xₖ]ᵀ[Q 0][xₖ]
334   * J = Σ [uₖ] [0 R][uₖ] ΔT
335   *    k=0
336   * </pre>
337   *
338   * @param <States> Number of states.
339   * @param <Inputs> Number of inputs.
340   * @param A System matrix.
341   * @param B Input matrix.
342   * @param Q State cost matrix.
343   * @param R Input cost matrix.
344   * @param N State-input cross-term cost matrix.
345   * @return Solution of DARE.
346   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if Q₂ isn't symmetric positive semidefinite.
347   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if R isn't symmetric positive definite.
348   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the (A₂, B) pair isn't stabilizable.
349   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the (A₂, C) pair where Q₂ = CᵀC isn't detectable.
350   */
351  public static <States extends Num, Inputs extends Num> Matrix<States, States> dare(
352      Matrix<States, States> A,
353      Matrix<States, Inputs> B,
354      Matrix<States, States> Q,
355      Matrix<Inputs, Inputs> R,
356      Matrix<States, Inputs> N) {
357    // Require R be symmetric
358    if (R.minus(R.transpose()).normF() > 1e-10) {
359      throw new IllegalArgumentException("R was not symmetric.\n\n" + R);
360    }
361
362    // Require R be positive definite
363    var R_llt = new LinearSolverSafe<DMatrixRMaj>(LinearSolverFactory_DDRM.chol(R.getNumRows()));
364    if (!R_llt.setA(R.getStorage().getDDRM())) {
365      throw new IllegalArgumentException("R was not positive definite.\n\n" + R);
366    }
367
368    // This is a change of variables to make the DARE that includes Q, R, and N
369    // cost matrices fit the form of the DARE that includes only Q and R cost
370    // matrices.
371    //
372    // This is equivalent to solving the original DARE:
373    //
374    //   A₂ᵀXA₂ − X − A₂ᵀXB(BᵀXB + R)⁻¹BᵀXA₂ + Q₂ = 0
375    //
376    // where A₂ and Q₂ are a change of variables:
377    //
378    //   A₂ = A − BR⁻¹Nᵀ and Q₂ = Q − NR⁻¹Nᵀ
379    var Rinv_NT = new SimpleMatrix(R.getNumRows(), R.getNumCols());
380    R_llt.solve(N.transpose().getStorage().getDDRM(), Rinv_NT.getDDRM());
381    var Q_2 = Q.getStorage().minus(N.getStorage().mult(Rinv_NT));
382
383    // Require Q be symmetric
384    if (Q_2.minus(Q_2.transpose()).normF() > 1e-10) {
385      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Q was not symmetric.\n\n" + Q_2);
386    }
387
388    // Require Q be positive semidefinite
389    var Q_2_es = Q_2.eig();
390    for (var e : Q_2_es.getEigenvalues()) {
391      if (e.real < 0.0) {
392        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Q was not positive semidefinite.\n\n" + Q_2);
393      }
394    }
395
396    // Require (A, B) pair be stabilizable
397    var A_2 = A.getStorage().minus(B.getStorage().mult(Rinv_NT));
398    if (!LinearSystemUtil.isStabilizable(new Matrix<>(A_2), B)) {
399      throw new IllegalArgumentException("(A, B) pair was not stabilizable.\n\n" + A_2 + "\n" + B);
400    }
401
402    // Find C in Q = CᵀC
403    var C_2 = new SimpleMatrix(Q_2.getNumRows(), Q_2.getNumCols());
404    for (int row = 0; row < Q_2.getNumRows(); ++row) {
405      var e = Q_2_es.getEigenvalue(row);
406      var v = Q_2_es.getEigenVector(row);
407      if (v == null) {
408        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Q was not positive semidefinite.\n\n" + Q_2);
409      }
410      for (int col = 0; col < Q_2.getNumRows(); ++col) {
411        // We use e.real because the eigenvalues of a real symmetric matrix are
412        // always real
413        C_2.set(row, col, Math.sqrt(e.real) * v.get(col, 0));
414      }
415    }
416
417    // Require (A, C) pair be detectable where Q = CᵀC
418    if (!LinearSystemUtil.isDetectable(new Matrix<>(A_2), new Matrix<>(C_2))) {
419      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
420          "(A, C) pair where Q = CᵀC was not detectable.\n\n" + A_2 + "\n" + C_2);
421    }
422
423    return dareDetail(A_2, B.getStorage(), Q_2, R_llt);
424  }
425}
